comparison.objective: Seat a filled syringe in a pump and bring its driver gently to the plunger; candidate transfers an uncaged LM block from rail to jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires flange-slot alignment and force-limited driver contact without dosing. Candidate requires bimanual rail–jig butt alignment and supported sliding without losing circulating balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a precisely seated flange and near-contact driver with no historical plunger displacement. Candidate requires complete transfer, every ball retained, no support separation, impact, contamination, or unsafe inclination.
comparison.reason: Both use delicate alignment, but pump loading tests protected contact with a plunger rather than continuous rolling-element containment across a support junction.
